row_number=2；1. Strong Revenue Growth with FY24 Slowdown=TCS delivered a strong 17.6% revenue growth in FY2023, increasing from ₹1,91,754 crores to ₹2,25,458 crores. However, in FY2024, growth slowed to 6.8%, with revenue reaching ₹2,40,893 crores. This slowdown was largely driven by reduced IT spending from global clients, especially in the Banking, Financial Services & Insurance (BFSI) sector, as businesses navigated macroeconomic uncertainty and rising interest rates in the US and Europe. Despite these headwinds, TCS still managed to maintain positive growth, highlighting the strength and resilience of its diversified client base.

This is higher than most companies, showing strong efficiency, smart use of capital, and good management.

parent_row_labels: TCS delivered a strong 17.6% revenue growth in FY2023, increasing from ₹1,91,754 crores to ₹2,25,458 crores. However, in FY2024, growth slowed to 6.8%, with revenue reaching ₹2,40,893 crores. This slowdown was largely driven by reduced IT spending from global clients, especially in the Banking, Financial Services & Insurance (BFSI) sector, as businesses navigated macroeconomic uncertainty and rising interest rates in the US and Europe. Despite these headwinds, TCS still managed to maintain positive growth, highlighting the strength and resilience of its diversified client base.
3. Steady EPS Growth Reflects Shareholder Value Creation

Earnings Per Share grew from Rs.104.75 in FY2022 to Rs.115.19 in FY2023 (10.0% growth) and Rs.126.88 in FY2024 (10.1% growth). TCS improved its ROE from 46.2% to 49.1%, meaning it earns about ₹0.49 profit for every ₹1 invested by shareholders. This is higher than most companies, showing strong efficiency, smart use of capital, and good management.
